name: pricing-table
useFor: Use on the pricing page. Mark one plan's key as primary (the ink hexagon); the rest are outlined. Prices take a monthly and yearly value, or one value.
constraints: A highlighted plan with a colored fill
source: The Hoplite website's pricing page (.pr-hero, .pr-plans: Free, Plus, Team, Enterprise)
title: Pricing table
description: The pricing page's plans: heading, lead and the billing toggle, then every plan in one stone frame split by hairlines, each with its node row, name, price, note, key and features or terms.
